dimensions.assessment: Affects federal employees transferred between the Department of Education and the Department of State, and institutions of higher education reporting foreign gifts and contracts.
dimensions.evidence: There are transferred to the Secretary of State all functions which the Secretary of Education exercised... under section 117 of the Higher Education Act of 1965

dimensions.assessment: Reassigns entire administrative responsibilities, personnel, records, and unexpended funds between two cabinet-level departments.
dimensions.evidence: the personnel employed in connection with, and the assets, liabilities, contracts, property, records... shall be transferred to the Department of State.

dimensions.assessment: Transfers unexpended appropriations and funds associated with the functions, with a requirement of no net increase in full-time equivalent employees.
dimensions.evidence: Unexpended funds transferred pursuant to this section shall be used only for the purposes for which the funds were originally authorized and appropriated.

dimensions.assessment: Alters administrative authority by shifting a statutory disclosure reporting program from one executive agency to another.
dimensions.evidence: There are transferred to the Secretary of State all functions which the Secretary of Education exercised...

dimensions.assessment: Permanent structural transfer of administrative functions and statutory oversight responsibilities between agencies.

missing_information: Exact dollar amounts of unexpended funds and precise numbers of personnel being transferred.
importance_detail.rationale: This bill transfers functions, personnel, assets, and appropriations related to foreign gift and contract disclosures under the Higher Education Act from the Department of Education to the Department of State, while mandating no net increase in full-time equivalent employees.
